title: Tuareg FLA Frees 60+ More Malian Soldiers at Niger Border in Third Prisoner Swap This Month
detail: The Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA) handed over more than 60 Malian soldiers to Niger's authorities at the two countries' border on August 28, 2026 — the third such release in less than three weeks, following 82 FAMa soldiers and 2 Wagner/Africa Corps personnel freed around August 13-14 and 22 more soldiers released around August 23. A Malian security source told AFP the swap also freed FLA field commander Inkinane Ag Attaher, arrested by Nigerien security forces near the Niger-Nigeria border in 2025, along with individuals reportedly linked to JNIM. Bamako and Niamey authorities did not publicly detail the exact terms; the released soldiers were transferred onto Nigerien territory, with their repatriation to Mali still being arranged by local authorities as of the exchange date.

title: FAMa Extends 'Operation Dougoukoloko' with Strikes on Militant Positions at Tessalit and Koutiala
detail: Mali's Armed Forces (FAMa) General Staff announced on August 28, 2026 that it conducted a new series of targeted strikes under 'Operation Dougoukoloko' — the same operation that hit JNIM logistics around Kidal and Abeibara in early August — this time against gathering points on the periphery of Tessalit (Kidal Region, far north) and against armed-group regroupment zones near Koutiala (Sikasso Region, south). The General Staff said intelligence had located several fighter groupings, including some armed-group leaders, and that the Tessalit strikes destroyed weapons stocks, armed vehicles, and fuel reserves used to sustain militant mobility. No independent casualty figures or corroboration beyond the military communiqué were available.
